description: Fix orphan issue recovery: smart build-stage recovery via tasks.json inspection + unconditional ACP process exit logging

tasks.title: Unconditional ACP session exit logging with phase
tasks.description: In acp-session.ts, modify both proc.on("exit") handlers (runAcpSession ~L139, createAcpConnection ~L515) to always write acp_session_process_exit workflow log with phase (init/running), exitCode, mode, and timestamp. Move writeSessionLog outside the if (!initialized && code !== 0) guard. Keep existing rejectOnSpawn/rejectOnInit logic unchanged inside the guard.
acceptanceCriteria: runAcpSession exit handler writes log with phase:'init' when !initialized and phase:'running' when initialized, mode:'single'
createAcpConnection exit handler writes log with phase:'init' when !initialized and phase:'running' when initialized, mode:'multi-round'
Existing rejection logic (rejectOnSpawn/rejectOnInit) still fires only when !initialized && code !== 0
Typecheck passes
Existing tests pass

tasks.title: Smart build-stage orphan recovery in recoverIssues()
tasks.description: Modify AgentRunnerService: add optional ProjectRepo + WorktreeManager constructor params. In recoverIssues(), for stage=build non-awaiting orphans: use findChangeDir() + fs.readFileSync(tasks.json) to inspect task progress. If all tasks pass → updateStage(review), keep active. If partial → blocked with progress summary log. If no tasks.json or invalid → blocked (existing behavior). Also wire the new params in server/index.ts where AgentRunnerService is constructed.
acceptanceCriteria: AgentRunnerService constructor accepts optional ProjectRepo and WorktreeManager params
server/index.ts passes projectRepo and worktreeManager to AgentRunnerService constructor
Build-stage orphan with all tasks passing: stage updated to review, status remains active, NOT blocked
Build-stage orphan with partial tasks: status=blocked, log contains progress summary (e.g. '2/3 tasks completed, T-003 pending')
Build-stage orphan with no change dir or no tasks.json: status=blocked, log mentions missing tasks.json
Build-stage orphan with invalid tasks.json: status=blocked, log mentions malformed tasks.json
Plan/explore stage orphans still get blocked (existing behavior unchanged)
Awaiting approval issues still restore pendingGate (existing behavior unchanged)
No ProjectRepo/WorktreeManager: recoverIssues() falls back to blind-block for all orphans
Typecheck passes
Existing tests pass
tasks.notes: Use findChangeDir from openspec/detector.ts (not detectOpenSpecChange, which requires tasks.json to exist). Import ProjectRepo type from db/project-repo, WorktreeManager from git/worktree-manager.

tasks.title: Reopen handler preserves review stage for auto-advanced issues
tasks.description: In api/issues.ts reopen handler (~L498), after issueService.reopen() returns: if issue.stage=review and tasks.json exists with all tasks passing (use findChangeDir + fs.readFileSync), return message 'reopened at review stage, use start to continue'. Otherwise keep existing message. No stage reset needed since issueService.reopen() doesn't reset stage currently.
acceptanceCriteria: Reopen on blocked issue at review stage with all tasks passing: response message contains 'reopened at review stage'
Reopen on blocked issue at other stages or without tasks.json: response message unchanged
Typecheck passes
Existing tests pass
tasks.notes: The reopen handler already has access to worktreeManager. Use the same tasks.json inspection pattern from T-002.

tasks.title: Tests for orphan recovery scenarios

Use in-memory DB + temp directories with real tasks.json files. Follow existing test patterns from agent-runner-service.test.ts.
